title: احسب القيمة للعدد المركب: \( \left(\cos\frac{7\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{7\pi}{12}\right)^{-3} \)

steps.title: الخطوة 1

model_solution: \( \left(\cos\frac{7\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{7\pi}{12}\right)^{-3} = \cos\left(-3 \cdot \frac{7\pi}{12}\right) + i\sin\left(-3 \cdot \frac{7\pi}{12}\right) = \cos\left(-\frac{7\pi}{4}\right) + i\sin\left(-\frac{7\pi}{4}\right) \). بإضافة \(2\pi\): \(-\frac{7\pi}{4} + 2\pi = \frac{\pi}{4}\). إذن الناتج \(= \cos\frac{\pi}{4} + i\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} + i\,\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).

model_solution: \( \sqrt{2}\left[\cos\frac{5\pi}{24} + i\sin\frac{5\pi}{24}\right]^{-4} = (\sqrt{2})^{-4} \cdot \left[\cos\left(-4 \cdot \frac{5\pi}{24}\right) + i\sin\left(-4 \cdot \frac{5\pi}{24}\right)\right] = \frac{1}{4}\left[\cos\left(-\frac{5\pi}{6}\right) + i\sin\left(-\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)\right] \). بإضافة \(2\pi\): \(-\frac{5\pi}{6} + 2\pi = \frac{7\pi}{6}\). إذن الناتج \(= \frac{1}{4}\left[\cos\frac{7\pi}{6} + i\sin\frac{7\pi}{6}\right] = \frac{1}{4}\left[-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - i\,\frac{1}{2}\right] = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{8} - i\,\frac{1}{8} \).
